rules.rule_description: Control logic is placed relative to the bank array and row/data periphery so that control spines can reach both sides cleanly.
rules.required_geometry: Control logic bbox and anchor relative to array center.

rules.rule_description: Delay/replica timing structures stay physically aligned to array-side replica geometry and feed control logic through explicit RBL routing.
rules.required_geometry: Replica BL geometry and delay-chain placement window.
rules.required_metadata: rbl source/target mapping and edge ownership.

rules.rule_description: precharge_en/sense_en/write_en/wordline_en must be distributed on explicit buses or rails to actual sink pins.
rules.required_geometry: Control spine segments, vias, and sink landing shapes.
rules.required_metadata: sink list by net and route layer ownership.

rules.rule_description: clk and buffered clock are routed as spines with defined branch points into control and DFF clusters.
rules.required_geometry: Clock trunk, branches, and via stacks.
rules.required_metadata: clock fanout map and route stack.

rules.rule_description: addr, din, and dout should originate from the corresponding flop/bank child pins and then escape to the perimeter through explicit routing.
rules.required_geometry: Instance-backed IO pins and escape routes.
rules.required_metadata: which instance owns each external IO bit.

rules.rule_description: Top-level pins belong on the perimeter after escape routing is complete and should correspond to routed internal geometry.
rules.required_geometry: Perimeter pin shapes and matching internal routes.
rules.required_metadata: top pin side, layer, net name, source instance.
